  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  merchant_id uuid NOT NULL,

);

  merchant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  customer_id uuid NOT NULL,
  request_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES customers.erasure_requests(id),
